_doc: 范围外登记：这些字符串不属于 Claude Code 的界面文案（内嵌 Monaco/VS Code 编辑器组件、KaTeX 词法组件、协议文本或内部标识），本汉化包不处理，理由逐类登记。

categories.label: 内嵌 Monaco/VS Code 编辑器组件的界面文案
categories.reason: Claude 的 Webview 内嵌了 Monaco 编辑器（差异预览）。这些是编辑器自身的菜单、命令与设置说明，属第三方组件文案，不属 Claude 界面。
patterns: ^(?:Whether|When enabled,|Uses the|Defines |Controls |Determines |Configure |Specifies |Maximum |Minimum |Timeout |Lines above|Tokenization |Line decoration|The (?:active |background |border |foreground )?color|This is the ARIA|If the diff|Editor )

\beditor\b|\bpeek\b|\bsticky scroll\b|\bbracket pair\b|\bsuggest widget\b|\boverview ruler\b|\bword wrap\b|\bcode action\b|\binline hint\b|\bsemantic token\b|\btoken color\b|\bminimap\b|\bgutter\b|\bbreadcrumb\b

categories.label: KaTeX 数学排版组件的词法/CLI 文案
categories.reason: KaTeX 用于渲染数学公式，其报错与 CLI 选项不会出现在 Claude 对话界面中。
patterns: ^(?:Invalid token|Unexpected token|Illegal value for token|Duplicate schema id)
^(?:Render |Limit the number of macro|Turn on strict)

categories.label: VS Code 本地化说明（写给翻译者的注释）
categories.reason: 这些字符串本身就是给本地化人员的说明（“不要本地化”之类），不是界面文案。
patterns: should not be localized|can be localized|refer to values the (?:different )?setting|viewport means the edge

categories.label: CSS 类名、尺寸与颜色值
categories.reason: 样式类名与数值，非文案。

categories.label: 内部标识符、上下文键与状态键
categories.reason: 代码内部使用的键名/ID，不是展示文案。

categories.label: 设置/插件清单的架构说明文本（zod describe）
categories.reason: 这些是 .claude/settings.json 与插件清单字段的 JSON-Schema 说明，用于编辑器悬停文档与内部校验提示，属开发文档面而非扩展界面；其对应静态文档 claude-code-settings.schema.json 亦未本地化。
patterns: must be valid identifiers|is not offered until Claude Code is updated|hooks\.json `surface` is gone

categories.label: 命令 ID
categories.reason: 命令标识符，不是展示文案。

categories.label: URL、路径、模型 ID 与内部键路径
categories.reason: 接口地址、文件路径、模型标识符与配置键路径，均非展示文案。

categories.label: JSON-Schema 校验库（ajv / zod）的内置消息与格式标签
categories.reason: 这些是校验库自带的通用报错与格式名（Number must be…、Invalid URL format、ISO date…），只在编辑 .claude/settings.json 等清单文件报错时出现，属第三方库文案。
patterns: ^(?:Number|String|Array|Date|BigInt|Object|Expected|Invalid|Intersection|No matching|It is default|Deprecated|`validateFormats|`nullable|`uniqueItems|Unions must|Enum must|Key must|Not must|AnyOf|OneOf|AllOf|Property )
^(?:must NOT|must be|must have|must match|must contain|should NOT|\$data|\{limit:)

categories.label: 内嵌 Monaco/VS Code 编辑器的命令名与设置项说明
categories.reason: 差异预览里嵌入的编辑器组件文案（Transform to…、Indent Using…、Inlay hints…、Tab Size…）。
patterns: ^(?:Transform to|Indent (?:Line|Using)|Outdent Line|Reindent |Trim Trailing Whitespace|Transpose |Shrink Selection|Set Selection Anchor|Selection Anchor|Quick Fix|Auto Fix|Fix All|Organize Imports|Go To (?:Top|Bottom) Hover|Page (?:Up|Down) Hover|Cursor (?:Redo|Undo)|Focus (?:Next|Previous) Cursor|Change (?:All Occurrences|Tab Display Size|the space size)|(?:Current|Configured|Default) Tab Size|Detect(?:ed)? Indentation|Developer:|More Actions|Exit Compare Move|Follow link|Enable/disable |Enables |Configures |Filter (?:elements|keyboard)|Highlight (?:elements|keyboard)|Inlay hints|This setting does not support|Lines will (?:never )?wrap|A multiplier to be used|Scrolling speed multiplier|Maps to `|The (?:opening|closing) bracket character|Do not apply the returned|A command that returns information about context keys|Invalid tree location)

^(?:Use |Smooth caret|Word breaks|Spaces and tabs|Special handling|The number of spaces a tab|Turn on/off use of tab key|Unusual line terminators|Renaming |Successfully renamed|Simple keyboard navigation|Use fuzzy matching|Use contiguous matching|Mouse Over|Vertical size|Source Action|Surround With|Switch Side|Unusual Line Terminators|No code actions available|Preview selected action|Default Language Configuration Overrides|Detected unusual line terminators|Convert Indentation|(?:Increase|Decrease) Editor Font Size|alwaysShowFoldIcons|No newer version)

categories.label: SVG 路径、CSS 值与字体名片段
categories.reason: 图标路径数据与样式值，非文案。
patterns: ^(?:xMinYMin slice|node of type |Token with |Infinite loop on byte|>= \(|>= \$|'wght')

categories.label: 模型/服务下线日期
categories.reason: 云服务模型的下线日期标记，属数据而非界面文案。

categories.label: 发送给模型的提示词/协议文本
categories.reason: 这些文本是喂给模型的提示与工具协议内容，翻译会改变模型行为，因此保持英文。
patterns: ^#\s|You have access to|mcp__|The user(?:'s| has| selected)|Your task is|Follow these guidelines|After completing your current task|This message was delivered by your host|^Note: The user|system-reminder
